request_payload.title: CDKL5 regulates p62-mediated selective autophagy and confers protection against neurotropic viruses.

mentions.sentence: Here, we identified cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5), known to function in neurodevelopment, as an essential regulator of virophagy.

candidates.label: Haploinsufficiency (one working copy is not enough)
candidates.summary: One of the two gene copies is lost or inactive, so the cell makes too little of a protein it needs. The remaining copy cannot cover the shortfall.

mentions.sentence: Loss-of-function mutations in CDKL5 are associated with a severe neurodevelopmental encephalopathy.
